# Art Explained Simply

> > Art Explained Simply demystifies iconic artworks from Leonardo da Vinci to Banksy, making art history accessible through clear analysis of symbolism, context, and meaning.

This site provides comprehensive explanations of famous paintings, sculptures, and installations across art movements from Renaissance to contemporary art. Each article breaks down the historical context, symbolism, and cultural significance of masterpieces by artists including John Constable, Yayoi Kusama, and Ai Weiwei.

## Key Topics

- art history
- symbolism interpretation
- painting analysis
- Renaissance art
- contemporary art
- Leonardo da Vinci
- religious painting
- landscape painting
- British art
- Surrealism
- Pop Art
- abstract art
- street art
- installation art
- art meaning

## Understanding Art

- [How to Read Abstract Art: A Simple Guide to Understanding Meaning](https://artexplainedsimply.com/how-to-read-abstract-art-meaning): Beginner guide to interpreting abstract art by Pollock, Kandinsky & others

## Renaissance & Classical Masterpieces

- [The Last Supper Explained: Uncovering da Vinci's Masterpiece Meaning](https://artexplainedsimply.com/the-last-supper-meaning): Da Vinci's Last Supper: Renaissance fresco with linear perspective & Judas
- [Leonardo da Vinci's Salvator Mundi: Faith, Art, and Mystery Explained](https://artexplainedsimply.com/leonardo-da-vincis-salvator-mundi-meaning): Da Vinci's Salvator Mundi: Renaissance faith, authentication, art market
- [Explaining Bosch's The Garden of Earthly Delights: Desire and Symbolism](https://artexplainedsimply.com/the-garden-of-earthly-delights-meaning): Bosch's Garden of Earthly Delights: triptych symbolism and human desire
- [Velázquez's Las Meninas Explained: Illusion, Power, and Mystery](https://artexplainedsimply.com/diego-velazquezs-las-meninas-meaning): Velázquez's Las Meninas: Baroque illusion with Infanta Margarita & royals

## 19th Century Art & Romanticism

- [John Constable's The Hay Wain Explained: Art, Nature, and Symbolism](https://artexplainedsimply.com/john-constables-the-hay-wain-meaning): Constable's The Hay Wain: symbolism in Suffolk's River Stour landscape
- [Liberty Leading the People Explained: The Meaning Behind Delacroix's Masterpiece](https://artexplainedsimply.com/liberty-leading-the-people-meaning): Delacroix's Liberty Leading the People: July Revolution 1830 symbolism
- [Wanderer above the Sea of Fog Explained: The Meaning Behind Friedrich's Romantic Masterpiece](https://artexplainedsimply.com/caspar-david-friedrichs-wanderer-above-the-sea-of-fog-meaning): Friedrich's Wanderer: German Romantic painting of man facing nature's sublime
- [Ophelia by John Everett Millais Explained: Symbolism and Tragedy](https://artexplainedsimply.com/john-everett-millais-ophelia-meaning): Millais' Ophelia: Pre-Raphaelite painting with Elizabeth Siddal & Shakespeare
- [The Card Players Explained: Why Cézanne's Masterpiece Changed Modern Art](https://artexplainedsimply.com/cezannes-card-players-meaning): Cézanne's Card Players: bridge from Impressionism to Cubism via Picasso

## Modern & Contemporary Art

- [Malevich's Black Square: The Art That Changed Modernism](https://artexplainedsimply.com/kazimir-malevichs-black-square-meaning): Malevich's Black Square: Suprematism and geometric abstraction revolution
- [The Son of Man Explained: The Meaning Behind Magritte's Mysterious Painting](https://artexplainedsimply.com/the-son-of-man-by-rene-magritte-meaning): Magritte's The Son of Man: surrealist identity and hidden face symbolism
- [American Gothic Explained: The True Meaning Behind Grant Wood's Iconic Painting](https://artexplainedsimply.com/american-gothics-true-meaning-grant-woods-vision-the-midwest-secret-that-changed-america): Grant Wood's American Gothic: Great Depression Midwest rural symbolism
- [The Great Wave of Kanagawa Explained: Meaning Behind Hokusai's Iconic Print](https://artexplainedsimply.com/hokusais-the-great-wave-of-kanagawa-meaning): Hokusai's Great Wave: Edo period ukiyo-e print with Mount Fuji symbolism
- [Girl with Balloon Explained: The Meaning Behind Banksy's Graffiti](https://artexplainedsimply.com/girl-with-balloon-meaning): Banksy's Girl with Balloon: London street art & Sotheby's shredding event

## Contemporary Installation & Conceptual Art

- [Infinity Mirror Rooms Explained: The Meaning Behind Yayoi Kusama's Art](https://artexplainedsimply.com/infinity-mirror-rooms-by-yayoi-kusama-meaning): Kusama's Infinity Mirror Rooms: endless reflections and immersive space
- [Sunflower Seeds by Ai Weiwei Explained: Art, Activism, and Symbolism](https://artexplainedsimply.com/ai-weiweis-sunflower-seeds-meaning): Ai Weiwei's Sunflower Seeds: Tate Modern porcelain installation on China
- [Io Sono Explained: The Meaning Behind Salvatore Garau's Invisible Sculpture](https://artexplainedsimply.com/io-sono-by-salvatore-garau-meaning): Garau's Io Sono: invisible conceptual sculpture meets quantum physics
- [Andy Warhol's Reigning Queens: The Meaning Behind His Royal Pop Art](https://artexplainedsimply.com/andy-warhols-reigning-queens-meaning): Warhol's Reigning Queens: pop art silk-screen of Queen Elizabeth II & others
